'''Hoit Pa'Doit''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] found in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="aotc exp vd">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Ultimate Illustrated Guide]]''</ref> Pa'Doit was present in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to see the local [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] named [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref>
